core.title: 12 Inch Spear Black Iron Forged Cane Bolt, Acorn MLGBP

text.description_html:
Acorn MLGBP, Spear Garden Gate Cane Bolt

The Acorn made 12 inch cane bolt is sturdy and has a a long handle for easy latching. Acorns MLGBP Spear Black Iron Forged Cane Bolt is perfect for securing any interior or exterior door, gate, and widow shutter.This piece is especially useful on garden or outdoor gates where black or iron hardware is desired. It features easy screw-in installation and comes packaged with installation screws hardware along with 3 door strikes: rim, mortise, and surface mount. The rough iron finish is guaranteed not to rust.

Specifications of the 12" Cane Bolt:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Backplate Length: 4"
  • Backplate Width: 2-3/4"
  • Bolt Length: 12" (including the handle)
  • Includes 3 strikes: rim, mortise, and surface styles.
  • Can be mounted vertically or horizontal

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!
